retrievalProfile.description: A glamorous mid-century portrait featuring a female vocalist in an over-the-shoulder pose against a dark, bokeh-filled background with high-contrast white serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated composition pairing a warm-toned glamour portrait of a woman looking back over her shoulder with a dark, atmospheric background of magenta and purple bokeh lights, anchored by large-scale white serif display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center looking toward the viewer
Large display typography overlapping the dark background on the left
High contrast between white text and deep magenta/purple shadows
Warm skin tones against cool-toned, blurred background elements
coreInvariants: Over-the-shoulder pose with direct eye contact
Dark background with circular bokeh light artifacts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up in a three-quarter rear view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point, balanced by the large display text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the back down, then moves left to the large typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and blurred background on the left provide space for the primary text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep magenta and dark purple background shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and pink tones in the subject's skin and attire
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; saturated magenta hues in the bokeh.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain deep black levels in shadows

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial capital for the primary display word

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned to display text left margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name/title paired with a wide, geometric sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Rectangular corner badge for secondary branding
Horizontal rule lines within the badge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast transitional serif style of the display text.
Matches the heavy, wide sans-serif used for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a glamorous 1950s-style portrait of a woman in a pink and white evening gown, looking over her shoulder. The background should be dark with magenta and purple circular bokeh lights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white serif text in the upper left quadrant. Below it, add a line of wide, bold sans-serif text in all caps. Place a small rectangular badge in the top right corner with thin white borders.

verificationChecks: Is the display text high-contrast serif?
Is the background dark with magenta bokeh?
Is the subject in an over-the-shoulder pose?
Is the text solid white without shadows?

recipe.reuseFormula: Glamour Portrait + Magenta Bokeh Background + High-Contrast Serif Display Type = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic
